User friendly. This app surprised me in that it is easy to use and navigate. It took some time to figure it out, but for the most part I have done so without too much trouble. The only problem I have run into so far has been when someone posts a photo in the feed, then I am unable to read their written post underneath because when I click on it I only see the photo. But I am thrilled to pieces that I found this app, this beautiful resource to connect with like minds. I also discovered later that TAE was in here and that I could follow it day to day. It’s really miraculous that this exists, that it’s free,
and that it is helping so many people world over. 
Thank you.

reviews.text: Seriously. I finally decided I might need some help. I registered and summited all my information. The app then says I have to answer questions before they will ”approve me” to use the app. Okay buzzard. The app then asks what the users primary goal is. I wrote that I wasn’t sure yet. Figured there would be more questions: there wasn’t. About 12 hours later I get a reply saying I was rejected. There was no feedback. Just rejected. Is this the right way to treat possible addicts. They finally reach out for help and you reject them?? Reaching out for help can be a very personal and difficult moment. And you tell them they can’t join your group? How do they think that makes the “applicant” feel. How does that reflect the mission for this organization? Seriously!

reviews.text: Review by Michelle on Day 6. I have been loving my time on the Alcohol Experiment. I love the blend of scientific knowledge around the physical aspects of alcohol on the body, mind and how the psychology of learning and habit formation has led us on a normal path that heavy and consistent use of an addictive drug has given rise to. This has helped me to become more self compassionate and lay of the blame and shame game where I felt useless and worthless to the point that sometimes it was hard to leave my bed in the morning never mind the house. I felt that everyone was talking about me and knew my shameful secret. The alcohol experiment isn’t just about the science and neural pathways of habit formation it also provides an online support community from across the globe with useful tips and resources as well as coaching support. I had already managed 25 days on will power alone so I have been alcohol free for 31 days and feel great. The Alcohol Experiment has been great in nurturing and supporting me in a positive was in my efforts

reviews.text: Exceeded expectations. Alcohol has plagued my family for generations and I STILL believed it was helpful. This program helped me gain inward insight and realize that alcohol is not my friend, and it doesn’t help me. Thank you SO much for this incredible program and the opportunity to be the real me again. I thought I LOVED alcohol, now I see it for what it really is and I despise it. I was a 20 year, 2L of vodka a week drinker and thought I always would be, this program helped me gain control over my life and has saved my family before it’s too late. My kids are happier, my husband is happier, and I am so much happier and healthier. Thank you so much Annie and Scott ❤️
